_comment: Sole-route glass A/B, arm 'on'. ONE binary — the arms differ only by $nav glass, which already existed. Batteries rotates after a round, so pinning it costs one launch per round; the driver alternates these two manifests. Arm 'off' = door-only routing (0.9.11 behaviour, with the known minor confound that geocost also reads panes as impassable). Arm 'on' = door-only first pass, panes admitted only when no door-only route exists.
